_comment: Pagine associazione seminate da MIRA per l'Università Bocconi.
Schede scritte a mano da fonti pubbliche (sito ufficiale dell'associazione + elenco
ufficiale Bocconi), non generate. Ogni riga porta le fonti in source_urls.
Nessun dato personale: solo l'organizzazione. Nessun logo scaricato.
Voce: prima persona plurale, in inglese, come le pagine scritte dai presidenti veri
(vedi Bocconi Students Blockchain Association e Bocconi Students for Value Investing).
Struttura volutamente diversa da scheda a scheda: divisioni, elenchi o prosa.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Investment Club
associations.short_description: We are the oldest finance association at Bocconi. Since 2010 we have been writing research on the markets — and we still do, every week.
associations.long_description:
We started in 2010 and received the University's official recognition in April 2011, which makes us the oldest finance student association at Bocconi.

Around 60 of us are active at any given time, working across three divisions.

CORPORATE FINANCE
Deal analysis and company valuation, from the mechanics of a transaction to the numbers behind it.

MARKETS
Coverage of what moves global markets, published as research on our website.

QUANT
Quantitative approaches to pricing, strategy and risk, for members who want the technical side of finance.

We recruit several times during the academic year, and we are open to any student enrolled at Bocconi.
associations.recruiting_timeline: Several recruiting sessions during the academic year.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Consulting Club
associations.short_description: The oldest and largest consulting club in Italy. We train our members to crack cases and to land the job they are aiming for.
associations.long_description:
We are the association for students who want a career in strategy consulting, and we are the oldest and largest consulting club in Italy.

What we actually do:

We visit consulting firms and meet the people who work there.
We run training sessions on frameworks, models and the skills you need to crack a business case.
We organise networking events with professionals in the industry.

We are 70 members from ten different nationalities. Getting in means passing our selection, which we run twice a year — around September and March.
associations.recruiting_timeline: Two selection rounds a year, usually in September and March.

associations.name: Minerva Investment Management Society
associations.short_description: The first asset management society at Bocconi. We run three proprietary funds and produce the research behind them.
associations.long_description:
We are the first and leading asset management student association at Bocconi University. Around 70 of us work across five divisions, and the divisions feed each other: the research decides what the funds do.

PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT
We manage three proprietary funds across a wide range of asset classes and investment products, applying our own macro outlooks and investment strategies, with the aim of stable income and long-term capital growth.

QUANTITATIVE
We measure the risk sitting inside our portfolios, using VaR methodologies, bootstrapping and portfolio optimisation.

EQUITY RESEARCH
We value companies across a wide pool of names, with DCF, multiples, DDM and LBO models.

MACRO RESEARCH
We follow macroeconomic news and market trends, and turn them into a view.

INVESTMENT RESEARCH
We identify the most attractive asset classes given current conditions, and publish monthly outlooks and reports.

associations.name: Bocconi Students M&A Circle
associations.short_description: Since 2014 we have done one thing: mergers and acquisitions. Deal analysis, valuation workshops, and the preparation that gets you through an interview.
associations.long_description:
We have been running since 2014, entirely student-led, for people who want to work in mergers and acquisitions.

We take apart recent deals and rebuild the reasoning behind them. We run valuation workshops where you do the work rather than watch it. We bring in guests from the industry, and we sit down with members on CVs, cover letters and interview preparation — the unglamorous part that decides most outcomes.

We are around 35 students, split evenly between bachelor and master, with eleven nationalities among us. We recruit twice a year, in October and in March.
associations.recruiting_timeline: Two recruiting rounds a year, in October and March.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Capital Markets
associations.short_description: We write about finance in the broadest sense — investment banking, asset management, hedge funds, private equity — with teams covering the Americas, EMEA and Asia.
associations.long_description:
We were the first association at Bocconi to take the word finance in its widest meaning: investment banking, asset management, hedge funds and private equity all belong here, and anyone who wants to write and argue about them has a place.

Most of what we do ends up published. Our members produce articles and analysis on global financial markets, organised in three teams by region: Americas, EMEA and Asia.

Alongside the writing, a good part of our work goes into preparing the members who are aiming at investment banking — M&A cases, mock interviews, and time spent with people who already do the job.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Private Equity Club
associations.short_description: One of the oldest associations at Bocconi, focused on private equity and venture capital in Italy and abroad.
associations.long_description:
We are one of the oldest and most active student associations at Bocconi, and our attention sits on two industries: private equity and venture capital, in Italy and internationally.

We publish articles on private equity and venture capital.
We interview professionals who work in the industry.
We run events with funds, advisors and academics.
We hold educational workshops for our members.

Our meetings run throughout the academic year, and most of them come back to the same question: what has actually changed in this industry recently, and why.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Finance Society
associations.short_description: Since 2013 we have put Bocconi students in the same room as the people running the financial industry.
associations.long_description:
We started at the beginning of 2013 with a simple idea: create a place where ambitious Bocconi students and senior people from the financial industry can actually talk to each other.

That happens through presentations, panels on what is moving markets right now, and networking sessions where the conversation continues after the talk ends.

associations.name: Bocconi Students Marketing Society
associations.short_description: Marketing at Bocconi, across four departments: consulting projects, digital, events and partnerships.
associations.long_description:
We work on marketing and communication, a field that matters as much to a multinational as it does to a start-up, and we are organised in four departments.

CONSULTING
Projects for companies, run by our members.

DIGITAL
Digital media and communication, where most of marketing now happens.

EVENTS
The moments that bring students, alumni, faculty and professionals into the same room.

PARTNERSHIP
The relationships with the companies we work with.

What holds it together is the network: we want our members to leave knowing people, not just concepts.

associations.name: Bocconi Students for Machine Learning
associations.short_description: The machine learning association at Bocconi. We build a network across tech companies, funds and research labs — and we ship projects.
associations.long_description:
We are the leading machine learning student association at Bocconi. Our aim is a network of minds spanning the best tech companies, investment funds and research labs, and using it to accelerate the careers of the people in it.

We design and run events: research talks, company sessions, project showcases, dinners with guests.
We set up partnerships — talks, hackathons, projects, interviews.
We publish what comes out of it, as articles, videos and presentations.

If you are working on something of your own, we help you carry it through: the code, the way you tell it, and getting it published.
